results.name: streamerChannel
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE streamerChannel (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  platform TEXT NOT NULL,             
  channel_url TEXT NOT NULL,          
  channel_name TEXT,                  
  created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)

results.name: streamerChannel_info
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE streamerChannel_info (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, 
  slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  profile_image_url TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  agency_name TEXT DEFAULT '개인세',
  debut_date TEXT NOT NULL,           
  debut_time TEXT NOT NULL,           
  timezone TEXT DEFAULT 'Asia/Seoul',  
  start_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,         
  created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, country_code TEXT
CHECK (country_code IN ('KR', 'JP', 'US') OR country_code IS NULL), x_url TEXT, group_name TEXT, video_url TEXT, website_url TEXT, event_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DEBUT' CHECK (event_type IN ('DEBUT', 'NEW_OUTFIT', '3D_DEBUT', 'ANNIVERSARY')), total_cheers INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, weekly_cheers INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, is_verified INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  FOREIGN KEY (channel_id) REFERENCES streamerChannel(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

results.name: debut_submissions
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE debut_submissions (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  platform TEXT NOT NULL,
  channel_url TEXT NOT NULL,
  avatar_url TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  agency_name TEXT DEFAULT '개인세',
  country_code TEXT DEFAULT 'KR',
  debut_date TEXT NOT NULL,
  debut_time TEXT NOT NULL,
  timezone TEXT DEFAULT 'Asia/Seoul',
  start_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
  x_url TEXT,
  contact_email TEXT,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK(status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED')),
  admin_note TEXT,
  created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  processed_at TEXT
, group_name TEXT, video_url TEXT, website_url TEXT)

results.name: portal_profiles
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE portal_profiles (
  slug TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  channel_url TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  data TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)

results.name: portal_pending_channels

CREATE TABLE portal_pending_channels (

)

CREATE TABLE portal_profile_channels (

CREATE TABLE portal_profile_history (
